headlines.text: Back on this day in 2024, there was a changing of the guard for the ROH World Six Man Tag Titles as Von Erichs & Rhodes vs. Undisputed Kingdom & Strong battled it out, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.84 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. For Von Erichs & Rhodes and Undisputed Kingdom & Strong, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. With Kevin Von Erich cheering ringside, Dustin Rhodes and the Von Erichs overcame Undisputed Kingdom interference and cowbell shots to win the vacant ROH World Six-Man Tag Team Titles.
Flash back to 2022, when Daniel Garcia vs. Bryan Danielson closed out Dynamite, rated 8.42 ? a fantastic contest ? part of a stacked Fight for the Fallen '22 - Night 1 card, rated 8.46 overall.

Looking back to 2024, when Hologram laced up for their first AEW match against The Beast Mortos, appearing on Collision, rated 7.88 ? a match that delivered. Making his AEW debut in a neon glowing vest, Hologram impressed the Arlington crowd in a strong showing against The Beast Mortos.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2022, Jon Moxley vs. Rush went to battle over the AEW Interim World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.70 ? a solid showing. It was the first title opportunity of Rush's career.
Flash back to 2024, when Mansoor stepped through the curtain for the first time, appearing on Collision, rated 6.71.

Turning the clock back to 2022: Thunder Rosa vs. Miyu Yamashita clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.55. Miyu Yamashita was challenging for gold for the very first time. It was the 30th time the AEW Women's World Title had been on the line, a significant milestone for the title.
